scope: LP SWD/RWDT timestamped reset order and dispatch barrier; no Bus/Soc/TIMG/shared edits

API.event: Actual nominal reset cycle; earliest pending event before equal-time source priority.
API.testOnly: take_reset_cause() wraps event API; historical SWD take_reset() keeps legacy fixture semantics.
API.owner: Apply reset_domains at selected reset timestamp before advancing beyond the boundary.
API.externalArbitration: Parent owns TIMG/LP Bus arbitration and cross-module snapshots; no rollback of retired CPU instructions is claimed.

behavior.SWDPending: Sticky actual epoch+EXPIRE; late pump and post-event feed/flag-clear do not alter it.
behavior.latePump: One fixed-size preview; adopt on no reset, otherwise commit only to first event time.
behavior.ordering: Earlier actual timestamp wins; equal SWD/RWDT times choose SWD.
behavior.dispatch: One event once, deadlineNone and no subsequent pump/take progression until owner reset.
behavior.sourceChange: Changed observation rejects while any event pending/dispatched; unchanged observation allowed.
behavior.reset: Acknowledge occurred/coincident events through owner time, retain CPU/Core count/stage/phase; do not catch up a second interval during reset.
behavior.legacy: Profile-off early return; unchanged register defaults, supported modes, source readiness, virtual SWD duration and reset reason values.

vectors.afterPostEventFeedAndFlagClear: Same timestamp, no completed feed or duplicate event.

checks.reason: Retention fixture expected dispatch-blocked deadlineNone after the owner reset.
checks.resolution: Retain complete state-equality assertion; normalize acknowledged pending/barrier and recompute next real deadline after reset.

checks.manualReview: Public pins/hashes and virtual controller vectors only; no private captures/local identities.

checks.result: PASS: empty diff; both historical receipts unchanged.

limits: Bus/TIMG event arbitration remains parent integration work.
No full shared build or original firmware run in this lane.
No physical reset pulse/stall or analog oscillator timing claim.
No rollback of retired instructions or arbitrary external late state.
privacy: Only public pins/hashes, deterministic virtual event vectors and aggregate test outcomes; no absolute local paths or raw private captures.
